goal: Return the business-day count between two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), excluding weekends
assumptions: Inputs are strings in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
The count is inclusive of both start and end dates.
Weekends are Saturday and Sunday; only these are excluded.
If start date is after end date, the function returns 0 (no negative counts).
Dates are valid calendar dates; no validation for invalid dates is required.
The function handles leap years correctly.
The function handles dates across year boundaries.
The function handles same-day input (returns 1 if weekday, 0 if weekend).
The function handles empty string inputs by returning 0 (no valid date).
human_question: For the date range 2024-02-26 to 2024-03-01, should the count include both endpoints (Mon–Fri = 5 business days) or exclude the start date (Tue–Fri = 4 business days)?
